note: Comments and email exports. In draft mode these are the judge for value defects. Each targets a section/field; some carry an explicit corrected value, some only flag (needs_review), and the two severity comments disagree (conflict).

corrections.author: reliability.lead@example.com
corrections.subject: firmware version is wrong
corrections.body: The affected version is firmware 4.2.1, not 4.2.0. Sites on 4.1.8 were not affected.

corrections.author: qa_reviewer
corrections.subject: duration and blank section
corrections.body: The outage duration is wrong (it was four hours, 02:14 to 06:31), and the Corrective Actions section is completely blank.

corrections.author: regional.director@example.com
corrections.subject: This is unacceptable
corrections.body: Severity 'Low' is unacceptable for a four hour data loss event. This should be High.

corrections.author: qa_reviewer
corrections.subject: severity assessment
corrections.body: Per the severity matrix a recoverable four hour degradation is Medium at most, not High.

corrections.author: qa_reviewer
corrections.subject: wrong figure
corrections.body: The chart in the Timeline section is the wrong image reference. It should be the packet-loss-versus-temperature figure.
